original_record.question: The diagram shows an equilateral triangle RST and also the triangle $T U V$ obtained by rotating triangle $R S T$ about the point $T$. Angle $R T V=70^{\circ}$. What is angle $R S V$ ? <image1>
original_record.solution: Since triangle $S T R$ is equilateral, $\angle S T R=60^{\circ}$. Hence $\angle S T V=130^{\circ}$. Triangle $S T V$ is isosceles (since $S T=T V$ ), so $\angle T S V=\frac{1}{2}\left(180^{\circ}-130^{\circ}\right)=25^{\circ}$. Thus $\angle R S V=60^{\circ}-25^{\circ}=35^{\circ}$.
